podcast.title: Brian May as Primary Influence
podcast.body: Adam Slack considers Brian May of Queen his greatest influence, even commissioning a custom KZ Guitar Works instrument that was directly inspired by one of Brian May's guitars. "If you had to ask Adam about his greatest influence, he would probably tell you it was Brian May of Queen."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Early Musical Influences
podcast.body: Adam Slack's musical upbringing included The Rolling Stones (especially Keith Richards), 1970s Glam Rock artists like David Bowie and T. Rex, and the band Queen. "He grew up listening to the Rolling Stones, he loves Keith Richards, 70s Glam Rock from Bowie and T. Rex, and Queen."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: New Young Band Inspired by Classic Rock
podcast.body: The Struts, a British band, were highlighted as a new young group "brought up on Queen, Aerosmith Oasis, the killers and the Rolling Stones." This demonstrates a trend of contemporary bands drawing direct inspiration from old school classic rock to create their sound, fitting into the Alternative Hard Rock space. "And we should also pay attention to the struts. A British band brought up on Queen, Aerosmith Oasis, the killers and the Rolling Stones."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of the 2010s Part 4: The Revivals

podcast.title: Reliable Les Paul from Mike McCready
podcast.body: He owns a full-size Les Paul that he purchased from Mike McCready of Pearl Jam, which he regards as his best instrument due to its consistent ability to stay in tune. "He actually calls this the best instrument he's ever owned because it never seems to go out of tune."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Baltimore Band in Alternative Hard Rock Scene
xref.body: Turnstile, a band from Baltimore, was mentioned in the context of new young bands inspired by old school classic rock, contributing to the Alternative Hard Rock scene in the 2010s. They were highlighted alongside Greta Van Fleet and The Struts as examples of this trend. "We should also bring in Baltimore's turn style."

xref.title: Guitar Sale to Adam Slack
xref.body: Mike McCready sold a full-size Les Paul guitar to Adam Slack of The Struts, an instrument Slack considers his best due to its exceptional tuning stability. "He also has a full-size Les Paul that he bought from Mike McCready of Pearl Jam."

xref.title: Major Influence on Adam Slack
xref.body: Queen, and specifically guitarist Brian May, were a major influence on Adam Slack of The Struts, inspiring his playing style and even custom guitar designs. "If you had to ask Adam about his greatest influence, he would probably tell you it was Brian May of Queen."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Transition to Highly Sought-After Mainstream Songwriter
xref.body: Despite The New Radicals being known for a single major hit, Greg Alexander successfully leveraged that into a long-term career as a highly in-demand and well-paid mainstream songwriter. He has penned songs for numerous prominent artists, including Santana, Enrique Iglesias, Geri Halliwell, Rod Stewart, Kaiser Chiefs, and The Struts, sometimes using pseudonyms. "Well, that's because he's gone on to write songs for Santana and Enrique Glesias and Jerry Hallwell and Rod Stewart and Kaiser Chiefs and the Struts and many others, sometimes under his own name, sometimes under a pseudonym."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
